text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, what a big box!\nThank you so much, 
Mirako-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's just convenience store snacks inside, 
though~ Ah, but still, I tried to pick 
things that Top Road-chan would like!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You're always working so hard in training, 
right? Being class rep seems tough too, so 
have something sweet and take it easy~

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Mirako-chan... To think you'd be so 
considerate! *gasp*!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well, it's not much of a thank-you, 
but would you like to hang out this 
weekend?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Actually, the present from my dad was a 
pair of soccer match tickets— would you 
like to join me?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
S-Spectator tickets...!? Your thank-you 
gift is way more extravagant than what I 
gave you?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That's not true! If it's with you, 
Mirako-chan, we can talk about soccer all 
we want. It's definitely, absolutely going 
to be fun!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
And we can eat these snacks together at 
the soccer stadium, okay?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeh, but then that'd just be way, way 
too much for me to receive~~!
